artifact_role: de-identified fitted conditional protein-transition concordance model

evaluation.interpretation: the joint dictionary has a modest collective reconstruction advantage; individual pathway attribution is not established by cohort-level removal
evaluation.protocol: eight deterministic held-patient folds with all source statistics and loadings refit; five deterministic held-gene folds within each held patient

fold_policy.gene_assignment: first sixteen SHA-256 bits modulo held-gene fold count
fold_policy.patient_assignment: SHA-256 ordering followed by balanced round-robin buckets

limitations: The held-patient evaluation is internal reconstruction, not external validation.
Reactome membership does not establish pathway activation, flux, or causality.
The collective conditional reconstruction advantage is modest.
Cohort-level leave-pathway-out results do not establish individual pathway attribution.
PI3K/AKT has no unique member in the fixed panel and remains overlap-confounded.
Missingness, preprocessing, sampling, and cohort transport remain limitations.
Outputs are non-prescriptive and are not recurrence or treatment predictions.

training_recipe.bootstrap_seed_policy: first 64 SHA-256 bits of source-content-digest, recipe-digest, and zero-based replicate index
training_recipe.design_row_scale: square root of union feature count
training_recipe.input_transition: paired recurrent T2 minus primary T1 protein abundance
training_recipe.pathway_adjustment: orthogonal projection against fitted global loading
training_recipe.pathway_shared_gene_weight: inverse square root of panel-membership degree
